notes: family: set-collection. Game end: the progress train reaching its required spot, or Train deck and discard both empty at the end of a turn; then every player (including the trigger) takes one final turn. Solo/scenario mode (rating Freeloader<50 up to Island Conductor 80+) not modelled. Verified against a faithful rulebook text mirror (RulesPal) and the BGG official rulebook listing; official PDF could not be downloaded without a BGG login.
